correctness.rationale: Finite-sample equality follows by the ℓ∞/ℓ1 quotient-norm dual for the full-row-rank affine moment matrix. Projected absolute deviations satisfy uniform a.s. LLN on the compact direction and median-shift domain, with positive limit c_d. Multivariate CLT and a rigorous uniform squeeze prove the chi limit and Rayleigh circle tail. Independent seeded primal/dual linear programs passed 72 cases; none is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The actual minimum near-equal weight tolerance on a random spherical degree-one cubature is a natural numerical design parameter left open by the motivating general existence theorem. Exact finite-sample optimization geometry and the sharp circle confidence threshold m ε²→(π²/4)log(1/δ) for fixed δ answer a practical probabilistic calibration question; the result is not merely a cosmetic constant substitution.
